title: Westpac Altitude Qantas or Velocity Black: 90,000 QFF/VFF with $6,000 Spend in 90 Days, $0 Fee for 1st Year ($295/Year Ongoing)
body:
Deal: Westpac Altitude Qantas or Velocity Black: 90,000 QFF/VFF with $6,000 Spend in 90 Days, $0 Fee for 1st Year ($295/Year Ongoing)

[Kazusa] Found this one on Reddit, but seems pretty good with $0 first year fee
[seanbaussie] Averages out to pretty much the same as all their offers now and previously: https://www.ozbargain.com.au/search/node/Altitude%20type%3Ao…
[dsar] Isn't this a duplicate? https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/956797
[nightelves] This one doesn't require you to have a Westpac account.
[dorikin] Both offers go through to the same link, which is a specific branch banking offer
https://www.westpac.com.au/personal-banking/credit-cards/bra…
[CptnObvious] Why do u have to pay QF fee even when you already have it?
[n0u] you can call up and get it waived after joining
[girafficlight] Just say you're already a member of what do you say?
[Onemoredeal] It’s not a Qantas FF joining fee, it’s a bank fee charged annually on top of the annual fee .
[extraverse] It's an annual fee to allow you to earn QFF points. Comes with any card. Even the Qantas Money cards themselves.
[tunzafun001] Used to be able to convert altitude points to Qff via woolies everyday rewards (to avoid the stupid fee).
Qantas still living in the glory days when Qantas was the premium.
They ruined velocity (in 2017 was getting dropped at the airport without a flight booked. Was that confident on getting a reward seat… Always got one ). Now can't find one to save myself.
Velocity is now what people want.
Qantas should be giving $75 to get Qff points instead.
[Amir66] You will receive an initial 90,000 bonus points if you spend $6k or more on eligible purchases within 90 days of card approval.
In your second year, spend a minimum of $6k on eligible purchases within 90 days of your card opened date anniversary, and you'll earn an additional 60,000 bonus points.
[GADGET TYPE OPERATOR] This card hasn't been great in terms of customer experience. App feels like it was built in the 90s. Can't disable dynamic CVV and insurance inclusions are very lightweight.
[noren7] The points are nice but the ride was so burdensome and took a lot of my time :(
I can't enable MFA via the app instead of SMS
Couldn't my identity online so had to in person (twice). The second time was because their system detected suspected application fraud after I made my first purchase. I verified that I was me already 😭
Had to keep ringing to progress my application because it wasn't done properly on their end
Months after I met the points requirements and still had 0 bonus points (just regular), I had to call to get the bonus points in my account because their system didn't process that automatically either 🙃
[Robbo014] Jumped from Westpac to Banksa, Westpac app is miles miles miles ahead of Banksa
[SirFrankGrimes] How are the insurance inclusions lightweight? You get full overseas travel insurance through Allianz yeah? Don’t see the issue…
[lawyerz] waiting for my 24 month to be up is like waiting for a prison sentence to be over..
[Sang11] I still have a year and 3 months lol. So sad
[richardhead] Will this be the last good reward offer since rba is banning surcharges?
[Onemoredeal] The surcharge ban is irrelevant, that’s a fee between retailers and banks to use their terminals and retailers not being allowed to pass it on etc . It’s the interchange fee that drops from 0.8% on transactions to a max of 0.3% causing this .
[Bahrgain Victorious] When it says can’t have had a Westpac rewards cars, does having had an Altitude Black World Mastercard count under that?
[CDG] Nowadays really hard to get card approved
[yoquierotaco] Anyone know of you cancel if annual fee would be pro-rata? This is because I am an idiot and forgot to cancel it
[prankster] Pro rata a thing of the past, banks know people get this and churn out after the points
[JHoliday] Velocity and Qantas cards used to be counted as separate streams (and hence you could be eligible for both) without having to wait out the existing customer time periods, I guess that is no longer the case?
[xaces] this vs https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/944480 ?
[Oh Boy] NAB is changing its earn rate, so if you ar eplanning to keep the card for a bit, this seems better on paper atm
[prankster] I applied back last year, got a standard mortgage paying it off no issues, got 8k in other credit cards - always paid on time so never got interest on it, earn pretty good money and guess what got rejected wtf lol
Thinking of trying the platinum card as when tried to get this one, got rejected then have to wait 30 days before applying for any Westpac product. And they can’t tell me why my application got rejected wtf
At that time I applied for that existing NAB Qantas cc deal which I got with no issues so yeah got the points & cancelled the card. Now looking for next deal ✌️
[ozmaxz] Anyone has experience using this card to pay off Zip. Will it earn points or does it count into eligible expenses for welcome bonus?
